description: CosmoNext is a team of passionate innovators interested in astrophysics, astronomy, physics, and technology. With experience in AI hackathons, we thrive on exploring complex ideas, solving problems, and turning challenging concepts into engaging solutions. For the Space Mission Design Game challenge, our goal is to build an interactive simulation that lets users design, manage, and test real space engineering trade-offs. We value creativity, open-minded discussions, and strong teamwork.
